t.1310-73-2.agn: The pure substance is in the highest corrosivity category (Skin Corr. 1A). Concentrated products such as drain openers carry the same statement on the label; in a diluted product the classification drops with the concentration.
t.1310-73-2.reg.clp: EU binding (harmonised) classification, CLP Annex VI index no 011-002-00-6 (CLP00): Skin Corr. 1A.
t.1310-73-2.what: Dissolves grease by saponifying it, breaks down organic blockages and raises the product's pH.
